name: landingV2-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project landingV2-e2e --web
// e2e: The @nx/playwright plugin infers a dependsOn shell:serve from the webServer.command in playwright.config.ts. That makes Nx start the shell AND Playwright start it again, racing on port 4200. Overriding dependsOn to [] lets Playwright's webServer own the single instance (it waits on `url` and reuses an existing serve). Mirrors apps/damoclesSword-e2e/project.json.
// ui: Playwright UI mode. Plain `--ui` opens a bundled-Chromium app window that doesn't surface on this machine; passing `--ui-host` takes Playwright's openTraceInBrowser path instead, opening UI mode as a tab in the default browser on an auto-assigned port (no port to type).
